name: EPIC 247352956
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 13, 10.7 solar radii and 1.30 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 4,810 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 13, give 1.30 solar masses and 10.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,086 K at its surface.
